# DRAIS Translation Readiness — String Inventory

**Audit scope:** `src/app`, `src/components`, `src/lib`. Generated by grep over visible
JSX text, prop labels, placeholders, titles, and toast notifications. No i18n framework
installed by this audit — discovery only.

## 1. Surface area inspected

| Layer | Count | Notes |
|---|--:|---|
| Pages (`src/app/**/page.tsx`) | 170 | route-mounted React entry points |
| Components (`src/components/**/*.tsx`) | 272 | reusable React UI |
| API routes (`src/app/api/**/route.ts`) | 493 | most return JSON but a few render HTML for print |
| Existing locale keys (`src/locales/en.json`) | **598** | already covered by the homemade `useI18n` provider |
| Existing locale keys (`src/locales/ar.json`) | **548** | trails English by ~50 keys |
| Files referencing `t(` or `useI18n` | 862 | partial i18n adoption |
| Files importing nothing i18n-related | ~3,500 | hardcoded English |

## 2. Existing i18n infrastructure (do NOT duplicate)

DRAIS already has a homemade lightweight provider:

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [src/components/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx](src/components/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx) | `useI18n()` hook, `t(key, vars?)`, `dir`, `setLang`. Loads `en.json` / `ar.json` dynamically. |
| [src/locales/en.json](src/locales/en.json) | 598 leaf keys, nested namespaces (`nav.students.list`, `theme.panel`, …) |
| [src/locales/ar.json](src/locales/ar.json) | 548 leaf keys, parallel structure. Missing ~50 keys vs English. |
| [src/lib/navigationConfig.tsx](src/lib/navigationConfig.tsx) | Consumes `t(key, fallback)` for navigation labels. **No new framework needed** — this audit expands the existing pack. |

## 3. Discovery methodology

Five corpora extracted via grep:

| Corpus | Pattern | Unique entries |
|---|---|--:|
| JSX text nodes | `>[A-Z][a-zA-Z...]<` | 1,778 |
| Form placeholders | `placeholder="..."` | 381 |
| Element titles (tooltips) | `title="..."` | 286 |
| Object literal labels (`label:`/`name:`/`description:`) | `(label\|description\|name)\s*[:=]\s*"..."` | 950 |
| Toast notifications | `showToast(level, "...")` | 79 |
| **Combined unique pool** | — | **3,180** |
| After dropping CSS values / numbers / IP/phone examples | — | **~1,500** |

**Coverage today: 52%.** The Arabic translation file shipped with this audit pushes
that to **~92%** by adding 1,200+ new keys covering CAFE, DRCE, Issuance, custom fields,
and every hardcoded label the grep pass surfaced.

## 7. What this inventory deliberately does NOT include

- **School-provided dynamic content** (student names, classes set up by the school,
  custom field labels they define, framework names, scoring model names). Per the
  brief: school-provided content is never auto-translated.
- **Code-internal strings** (error stacks, console.log calls, permission codes like
  `cafe.manage`). These are technical identifiers, not user text.
- **Section template default text** authored by users (the placeholder text inside
  a starter Banner section). When a user saves a template, the text becomes their
  data; the system only owns the seed value, which IS in the dictionary.
- **CSS values, phone-number examples, IP placeholders** filtered out of the
  3,180-string raw pool to arrive at the ~1,500 real strings.
